title: Russian deception as source of some UAP
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of Russian deception as source of some UAP, about unspecified at Russia, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
>> And the Russians in particular really do
a lot of this.

plain: A guest named Eric Hazeline, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former director at the NSA, the US agency for electronic spying and codebreaking, says some UAP, the official term for unidentified objects in the sky, come from deliberate deception. He says the Russians in particular do a lot of this, and he cites the general George Patton. If true, it would mean some sightings are tricks by a rival country.
